title: Return
wikitext:
'''Return''' is a behaviour of [[projectile]]s that causes them to attempt to return to the entity that fired them after they collide with a target, terrain, or when they reach their maximum travel distance.

==Mechanics==
Only one projectile behaviour can be applied each time a projectile collides with a target. Return has fifth priority for projectile behaviours, preceded by [[split]], [[pierce]], [[fork]] and [[chain]].

Return can occur when a projectile collides with a target, with terrain, or when it reaches maximum projectile distance. When a projectile returns, it changes direction toward the entity that fired it (or its last known location). Typical projectiles will travel to that location and then continue for another 15 metres.<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3373661/page/2#p24964202</ref> A projectile can only return once. 

Returning projectiles can collide with a previously hit target (as long as the projectile did not return directly from that target). If a set of multiple simultaneously-created projectiles returns, only one projectile in that set can collide with the same target. Projectiles after the first will pass through without dealing damage.<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3284453</ref><ref name="SplitShotgun"/> 

Returning does not reset travel distance or projectile duration, thus skills with limited duration/distance, such as {{il|Ball Lightning}} or {{il|Spark}} may expire before reaching their maximum distance, leaving them unable to return unless their projectile speed or duration is increased.

===Interactions===

Different skills have different interactions with return: 

* Some projectiles cannot return:
** Projectiles that cannot collide with enemies and end on collision with the ground, such as [[Concoction]] skills, {{il|Forbidden Rite}}, {{il|Winter Orb}} 
** Rain-type projectile skills like {{il|Blast Rain}} or {{il|Rain of Arrows}}
** {{il|Tornado Shot}}'s secondary projectiles
** {{il|Spectral Shield Throw}}'s shard projectiles
** {{il|Splitting Steel}} and {{il|Splitting Steel of Ammunition}} projectiles
** {{il|Venom Gyre}} projectiles if fired by {{il|Whirling Blades}}
** {{il|Spark}} and {{sl|Twister}} projectiles, which move according to their own mechanics and end when their [[duration]] expires<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3324396/page/4#p24929718</ref> 

* Some projectiles require a certain projectile speed to return without colliding 
** {{il|Scourge Arrow}}'s thorn arrows 
** {{il|Ethereal Knives}} 
** {{il|Frost Blades}} 

* Some projectiles need to collide with a target or terrain to return: 
** {{il|Freezing Pulse}} 

====Skill-specific behaviour or exceptions====
* {{il|Molten Strike}} projectiles return to the user when they collide with the ground 
* {{il|Volcanic Fissure}} projectiles will bounce and land near their first landing
* {{il|Ethereal Knives}} or {{il|Ethereal Knives of the Massacre}} projectiles will rarely if ever return unless they collide with an object. {{il|Ethereal Knives of Lingering Blades}} projectiles will fully return and each projectile will leave a [[lingering blade]] adjacent to the location it was originally cast.
* {{il|Uul-Netol's Embrace}}'s {{sl|Bone Nova}} and {{il|Cameria's Avarice}}'s {{sl|Icicle Burst}} can trigger from hits by their own returning projectiles. (Only a single projectile can collide with an enemy on return per usual [[Projectile#'Shotgunning'|shotgun prevention]].)
* {{il|Voidfletcher}}'s {{sl|Void Shot}} will attempt to return before exploding, if it has enough duration and projectile speed to do so.
* {{il|Shrapnel Ballista}}'s projectiles behave erratically and appears to not fully shatter all projectiles; unshattered projectiles can return to the ballista. The effect is more pronounced with {{il|Fork Support}} and optionally {{il|Arrow Nova Support}}.

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.21.0|
* Simplified projectile [[return]]ing. Previously some effects that caused projectiles to return specified they only did so at the end of their flight, others only from a final target, and a few from either case. Now all effects that cause projectiles to return do so in any case that they can.
* Projectiles which explode or otherwise destroy themselves only when they cannot move further, such as {{il|Fireball|fireball}}, which return will now consistently not do so until after they have returned, just like they don't do so before piercing, forking, or chaining if they have those behaviours. Previously this was inconsistent. As a general rule, if a projectile wouldn't do something when it pierces or chains from an enemy and continues on, it also won't do that when it hits an enemy and returns from them.
* Projectiles from skills which force them to explode or otherwise destroy the projectile before checking for other behaviours, such as the [[Concoction]] skills, will now consistently prevent returning, just like this prevents other projectile behaviours.
* Projectiles which initially fire at a specific location rather than in a direction, such as {{il|Caustic Arrow}}, now ignore this when returning, so they will continue past you until they hit something.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
